MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, JANUARY 23, 2023 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chairperson Domier called the regular meeting to order at 8:02 a.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairperson Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl (arrived at 8:04 a.m.), Alternate Wu, Trustee
  Chien, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier

  ABSENT: Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

Chairperson Domier shared how wonderful the Open House event was, with all Library support
groups in attendance.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Vice Chairperson Sadun spoke about an article she read regarding the war in Ukraine, and how a
few organizations are helping to preserve archives by digitizing records stored at libraries.

Alternate Wahl shared that she attended the Open House event on Saturday and appreciated all
the activities for the kids.

Trustee Chien and Alternate Wu did not have anything to report.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that Linda Mollno’s exhibit has ended, and the current exhibit
displays the history of the Crowell Public Library. She shared that the next display will be mixed
media pieces from 5 artists of Studio 1034 from February 8 to March 31, with a reception on
February 25. The next booked display will highlight a Chinese calligrapher from May 27 to July 7,
with a reception on June 3.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
JANUARY 23, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 3

4. SAN MARINO CENTER RENOVATION UPDATE REPORT

Chairperson Domier requested that this item be removed from future agendas since updates on the
San Marino Center are available on the City’s website and included in the monthly Director and
Library Manager Report.

5. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
Library Manager Vera reported that the Friends have been discussing their dinner event scheduled
for March, membership numbers, and plans for the One Book One City program. Director Johnson
added that the Friends were acknowledged at the Open House event as “Volunteers of the Year.”

6. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien reported that Foundation did not have a formal meeting last month, and will meet
once every two months moving forward. She shared that the Foundation is considering moving the
Delicious Destinations event to Spring, in hopes of having higher participation numbers.

NEW BUSINESS

7. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Chien moved, seconded by Vice Chairperson Sadun, to approve the minutes from
November 28, 2022.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Chien, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda

8. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

Chairperson Domier inquired if the patio furniture can be replaced at the Library in conjunction
with the new patio furniture for San Marino Center. Director Johnson responded that new furniture
will be procured. Vice Chairperson Sadun added that at the Open House, several people noted that
upholstery, carpeting, and woodwork need repair or replacement. Director Johnson responded that
staff are aware and are working with the Parks and Public Works Department to get the items
addressed. Alternate Wahl inquired about the status of the Teen Advisory Group (TAG). Library
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
JANUARY 23, 2023  PAGE 3 OF 3

Manager Vera responded that the TAG group met last week and shared some of the projects they
will be working on.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

9. LIBRARY DIVISION SCHEDULE OF FEES FOR SERVICE FISCAL YEAR (FY)
  2023-24

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

Vice Chairperson Sadun spoke about an article she read regarding library fines, and how a lot of
large library systems are eliminating overdue fines. She asked if the Library will continue to charge
fines. Library Manager Vera shared that she would love to go fine free, as fines are punitive. She
added that libraries that have gone fine free have been able to recover more items, in addition to
keeping patrons. She shared that no library in the San Gabriel Valley has gone fine free. Director
Johnson shared that staff will do further research and present a recommendation to the Board next
month.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

Trustee Chien moved, seconded by Vice Chairperson Sadun, to support staff's recommendations to
the FY 2023-24 Schedule of Fees for Service.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Chien, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Dornier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  None

ADIOURNMENT

Chairperson Dornier adjourned the meeting at 9:04 a.m.
